messages.subject: Treatment (fixed effect) and time interaction
parts:
Hi all!

 

I’m trying to fit a space-time model to animal count data, and I have a problem that I was hoping someone might be able to help with. The counts are conducted at different sites within different treatment groups and the goal is to compare the changes over time between the different treatment groups.

 

We would like to fit a model that includes a smooth effect of space and a smooth effect of time that varies by treatment. I’ve managed to use the group argument to fit a model including an interaction between space and time, but I cannot find how to add an interaction between the categorical treatment (a fixed effect) and time.

 

Any help is greatly appreciated.

 

Thanks in advance!

 

Holly
